The HQ palette display now reads the new measured section and the 48 runtime sheets plus tool icons. Pixel inventory and 51/51 local HQ test files passed; GitHub Actions gateway, writing and tests all passed on 05d4fb2. Commits e703c3c and 05d4fb2 are on origin/main; no look treatment was approved.
